test_inputs.explanation: The admin_url is taken directly from the agent execution steps (the repeated navigation target). The execution log did not expose explicit values for the category fields, so to produce a reproducible test we select a common workable set: creating a new root category ('root') named 'Automated Test Category', marked active ('Yes'), and using a 30s wait timeout (the recommended default). These values will allow re-running the category-creation flow starting from the recorded admin page.
